text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout: blue -> green shift in eu-west for service 'infer-gateway' (batch=20%, wave=2)
Alex M: seeing alerts from synthetic, lots of 502s in eu-west-2-canary within the last 2m
Priya S: confirmed, dashboard shows error spike exactly aligned with canary traffic increase :eyes:
Kevin (oncall): paging — I'm on it, putting pager duty notes in Opsgenie
incident-bot: @Kevin (oncall) — Incident declared: INF-2026-0423 (eu-west canary errors). Severity: P1.
Dan R: any deploy tag? what commit?
Alex M: deploy ID `deploy/2026-04-23-eu-bluegreen-42`
Jess L: quick look — logs show TLS handshake failures from edge to green instances: `tls: handshake failure`
Priya S: that's odd, green was built from the same image as blue, only config toggle changed.
Kevin (oncall): pulling logs now, running `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=infer-gateway,env=green --since=10m`
Kevin (oncall): output: ```
Apr 23 12:14:02 infer-gateway[1]: tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: unsupported_protocol
Apr 23 12:14:03 infer-gateway[1]: connection from 10.4.8.12: remote closed
```
Dan R: remote error: unsupported_protocol could be an ALB -> instance protocol mismatch (ALPN/TLS version) or a kernel openssl change
Alex M: ALB config was untouched. but we did flip a feature-flag that enables http2 muxing on green instances.
Priya S: http2 muxing requires ALB to support h2. Our edge is a mix of ALBs and legacy LBs in the region during the weighted shift.
Maria (Support): any ETA for mitigation? customers on eu-west seeing bursts of 502, some enterprise customers flagged support tickets.
Kevin (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout, 2) flip feature flag kill-switch for green to disable http2 muxing, 3) if traffic doesn't recover, rollback green entirely.
Jess L: pausing rollout now via rollout service: `POST /api/rollouts/2026-04-23-eu-bluegreen/stop` -> 202 Accepted
deploy-bot: rollout 2026-04-23-eu-bluegreen paused by Jess L
Priya S: flipping feature flag `green_http2_mux` -> `off` via FF service (target=green instances)
Priya S: command: ```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.internal/feature/green_http2_mux/off -d '{"scope":"eu-west","target":"green"}'
```
Priya S: flag flip propagated, watching metrics
Alex M: synthetic shows errors decreasing but still a tail of failing connections, looks like ~10% of traffic still hitting older LB paths that don't speak h2
Dan R: could be DNS caching on some regional edge nodes — remember we changed internal edge weights and there's a short TTL mismatch between ALB address sets (~300s) and edge caches (120s)
Kevin (oncall): good call. if some clients still target green with http2 enabled earlier, they'll keep hitting it until connection attempts stop or DNS TTL expires. We should do a temporary fallback: route traffic away from green via routing kill-switch while DNS settles.
Jess L: applying kill-switch: `route-manager set-weight --service infer-gateway --region eu-west --green 0` -> returns `ok`
deploy-bot: route weight update applied: green=0% for infer-gateway in eu-west by Jess L
Priya S: within 30s we should see load drop on green. monitoring...
Alex M: load on green dropping to zero, error rate returning to baseline :tada:
Maria (Support): I sent a note to impacted customers: "We observed a partial rollout to eu-west that produced elevated 502 responses for a subset of requests. We paused the rollout and disabled a new http2 optimization. Most traffic recovered within minutes; some retries may have occurred. If you saw persistent failures, please reply with request IDs and we'll investigate."
Kevin (oncall): handoff — @Dan R taking next-shift oncall for follow-up (shift ends in 50m). I'll update Opsgenie and hand off runbook.
Dan R: taking it. action items: 1) confirm rollback not needed, 2) audit ALB/LB capability matrix vs feature flags, 3) add TTL alignment ticket for edge caches + ALB IP sets.
Kevin (oncall): confirmed, no rollback needed for now. customer impact window ~ 5-8 minutes for most, some caches extended the tail up to ~3m beyond that.
Priya S: will open postmortem draft, initial blame: feature-flag + rolling weights + TTL mismatch.
Jess L: saving relevant artifacts: deploy logs, ALB config diffs, route-manager audit, ff-service audit into incident folder `INF-2026-0423`
incident-bot: incident INF-2026-0423 updated: status=mitigated, severity=P1 -> P2, runbook_owner=Dan R
Maria (Support): I'll follow up with customers in the morning with a short root-cause note and ETA for a full postmortem.
Alex M: suggestion for next steps before retrospective: add a canary policy check that prevents http2-enabled images from receiving traffic in regions with mixed LB capabilities, or require a canary smoke test that validates ALB handshake for new flags.
Dan R: agreed. adding ticket: `ENG-ops-924 - enforce handshake smoke test + TTL alignment`
Kevin (oncall): closing oncall notes. If anything urgent pops up, page me. nice work team :heart:
Maria (Support): reactions: :thumbsup: :pray:
Jess L: logging final status: mitigated at 12:21:03 UTC, postmortem draft started.
